title: Score each label, mind the schema (28 Oct 2026)
summary: LinkedIn turns a fine-tuned 1.5B labeler from list generation into per-candidate scoring, a preregistered study shows a schema minimum makes open models pad extraction lists, cost-aware abstention for IT ticket routing where fine-tuned DistilBERT beats prompted LLMs, a controlled LoRA versus full fine-tuning study for prompt-safety classifiers, and Atos fine-tuning small models for German hate-speech feature extraction.
